The doctor and staff clearly explained everything, including the treatment process, medication, and cost breakdown. They were very patient and understanding, especially when I mentioned I am not very tolerant to pain. The doctor made sure I was comfortable and would pause or take action accordingly instead of just proceeding without checking.

The extraction itself was surprisingly fast — it was done in about 30 minutes. I was quite nervous because I had been afraid to remove my wisdom tooth since 2018, but the procedure was so smooth that I didn’t even realize it was already finished.

The cost was very reasonable compared to what I expected. After taking the prescribed medication, I felt comfortable at night, and even today there is minimal to no pain, which is very different from what I had expected based on other people’s experiences.

Overall, I am very relieved and grateful. I would definitely recommend Klinik Alya for wisdom tooth extraction, especially for anyone who is anxious about dental procedures.

Crown:
After braces I was recommended bonding or crown as my teeth still has gap because of peg lateral tooth. At first i choose bonding but it broke and stained. After that I was recommended crown. The doctor  didnt explained fully about the crown at all. I asked the doctor if they shaving tooth a little and does the crown feel like real teeth. The doctor said yes. The doctor dont recommend veneer at other clinic (this clinic dont provide veneer). After crown installation, the crown feel too bulky and doesnt feel like real teeth at all. I made few adjustment after but still not feel comfortable after 7 months+. I even asked to pull out my crown but the doctor said the tooth will be very sensitive. Then I asked 2nd opinion from 3 doctor from 2 clinic (general dentist, endo and prosthodontist). They said the crown does not installed correctly. Then I went to prosthodontist to put new crown. Right now it feels like 90%, 95% real teeth. Maybe need some time.

Filling (possible cause?)
Had filling at clinic A. But after the filling, tak boleh paklai retainer. Then i go adjust, after the adjust the tooth feel pain when wearing retainer. The doc didnt give painkiller. The doctor said need to wait few weeks. I was dumb and go to this clinic. Pegi sbb nak minta 2nd opinion. Kalau doc ckp tampalan ok saya tahan je la. The doctor  said the filling is not enough. But after the filling, I think its the worst filling i had. I cant even floss the teeth. Then I went to the doctor to adjust the filling. After few days the pain goes away (maybe because of time) and can floss. But after few months, my teeth feel sensitive. Went to clinic A again sbb taknak banyak sangat tangan. And they said my teeth had fracture. Had to do large filling because of that. Few months after my teeth still feel sensitive. Clinic A said because there microleakage. The doctor redo the filling but after a week still feel sensitive. The doctor suggest do root canal or endo. I went to endo and he said only need to do filing. So far my teeth feel 85% ok. The endo said need to wait few weeks

Update: still rasa sakit. Lepas buat root canal still rasa sakit. Then after do cbct scan the doc said i had root fracture. Went to another endo she said dont have crack. but after root canal by 2nd endo still feeling pain. The doc refer me to pain specialist as she said i might have trigeminal neuralgia

TLDR: Come to this clinic is the WORST decision of my life. Dont think i have this issue if i didnt do braces filling here.

reviews.name: SY
reviews.text:
I recently visited Klinik Pergigian Shiny for a sensitive tooth issue and teeth cleaning. Unfortunately, my experience was very disappointing.

I initially came for advice and a solution for a sensitive tooth with an obvious hole. However, the dentist informed me that 3 other areas required fillings due to cavities. When I asked about the cost, I was told it would be around RM100 per filling, so I expected a similar range. However, I was eventually charged RM150 for 2 teeth and RM120 for another tooth.

The entire session, including scaling, took less than 15 minutes, with a total charge of RM540. I was asked by the nurse to arrive on time as the dentist needed to leave at 6pm. Although I arrived on time, I was only attended to close to 5.45pm despite no other patients being present. The treatment felt rushed, and I did not receive the detailed explanation, advice, or professional guidance that I normally receive from other dentists.

If the treatment had resolved my issues, I would have accepted the cost. However, after the scaling and resin-based composite fillings, 3 teeth (not the original sensitive tooth I came in for) became sensitive, and one tooth started hurting when biting — issues I did not have before the appointment.

I monitored the condition for a few days, but the sensitivity and pain persisted. I eventually visited my regular dentist, who identified that one filling was too high and causing the biting pain. After adjustment, that issue improved. However, the sensitivity problem remains, and I have needed multiple dental consultations since then.

What disappointed me most was that my original concern was not properly addressed. The sensitive tooth with the obvious gap/hole was eventually resolved by another dentist, who clearly explained my condition, treatment options, and long-term management plan. At Klinik Pergigian Shiny, I was only advised that it was “hypersensitivity” and that nothing could be done.
As patients, we are not only paying for the procedure itself, but also for proper diagnosis, explanation, and professional advice.

This is the first time I have experienced so many dental problems after a dental appointment. More than 2 weeks now, I am still dealing with the dental issues that developed after the treatment at this clinic, resulting in additional costs, multiple dental visits, and time spent trying to resolve them.
